title: Rukh
subtitle: From the Shadows
text:
Support (When you play this unit, you may attack with another unit. It gains this unit's other abilities for this attack.)
When Attack Ends: If the defending unit was defeated, you may give 3 Advantage tokens to a unit.
rules: When Attack Ends abilities trigger at the same time as units deal combat damage. Rukh (or the supported unit) does not need to survive the attack in order to give Advantage tokens, so long as the defending unit was defeated.
